claims.summary: The current research/source pipeline was audited across genome linking, OpenAlex/OpenLibrary/OpenStax handling, source ledger shape, CourseIR sourceRefs, package proof, QUALITY_REPORT, and grader checks.

A trusted source-ledger normalizer now produces academic/OER rows with title, authors, URL/DOI, license, provider, concept links, checkedAt, access status, trust level, citation label, and license ambiguity flags.

CourseIR now treats worked examples and assessment prompts as sourceRef-bearing atoms, records atom sourceRef coverage, and feeds source-ledger labels into supporting resources before deterministic compile.
Downloaded packages now export sourceLedger, sourceLedgerSummary, CourseIR sourceRef coverage, and SOURCE_REPORT.md as bibliography/source receipts.

The deep grader now checks exported source-ledger proof for fake or incomplete citation rows, missing or dangling sourceRefs, inaccessible source rows, unsupported factual claims, and ambiguous licenses.
